reviews.title: Incredible App!!! 5 STARS!!!!!
reviews.body: This is my new favorite app! Very easy to browse and stream content from archive.org. Best of all, no ads whatsoever!!!! Please keep it that way. Thank you so much for developing this and releasing it for iOS and macOS. I can use it on all my devices iPhone, iPad & MacBook.
reviews.author: JMenkin

reviews.title: I’ve always wanted this!
reviews.body: Works really well. Interface is intuitive and the feature set is absolutely bonkers. Curated channels? Random modes? A clip editor for sharing? Direct link to donate and support archive.org?? Unreal!! I’ve been wanting to make something like this for a long time. Before attempting to tackle this with AI (I have a life outside development lol) I figured I’d search again for something someone already made, and here it is. Thank you.
reviews.author: Denzel_Denzel
